title: Sparkly key
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE566" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFE566" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="keyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FFC107"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E6A800"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="keyShine" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF3B0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sparkle glow halos -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="8" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="15" r="6" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="70" r="7" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="75" r="5" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="5" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Key body (shaft) -->
  <rect x="35" y="42" width="14" height="46" rx="3" fill="url(#keyGrad)" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Key shaft highlight -->
  <rect x="37" y="42" width="4" height="44" rx="2" fill="#FFE566" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Key bow (circular head) -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="32" r="20" fill="url(#keyShine)" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Inner hole of key bow -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="32" r="9" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="32" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#E6A800" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Bow highlight arc -->
  <path d="M 28 24 A 18 18 0 0 1 52 22" fill="none" stroke="#FFF8DC" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Key teeth (notches) -->
  <rect x="35" y="78" width="22" height="8" rx="2" fill="url(#keyGrad)" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="49" y="78" width="8" height="12" rx="2" fill="url(#keyGrad)" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="49" y="86" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E6A800"/>

  <!-- Sparkle 1: large four-point star top-left -->
  <g transform="translate(18, 16)">
    <polygon points="0,-10 2.5,-2.5 10,0 2.5,2.5 0,10 -2.5,2.5 -10,0 -2.5,-2.5" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
    <polygon points="0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 2: medium four-point star top-right -->
  <g transform="translate(80, 14)">
    <polygon points="0,-8 2,-2 8,0 2,2 0,8 -2,2 -8,0 -2,-2" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
    <polygon points="0,-5 1.2,-1.2 5,0 1.2,1.2 0,5 -1.2,1.2 -5,0 -1.2,-1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 3: small four-point star bottom-left -->
  <g transform="translate(12, 68)">
    <polygon points="0,-7 1.8,-1.8 7,0 1.8,1.8 0,7 -1.8,1.8 -7,0 -1.8,-1.8" fill="#FFE566"/>
    <polygon points="0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 4: small four-point star bottom-right -->
  <g transform="translate(86, 72)">
    <polygon points="0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
    <polygon points="0,-3.5 0.8,-0.8 3.5,0 0.8,0.8 0,3.5 -0.8,0.8 -3.5,0 -0.8,-0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 5: tiny diamond top-center -->
  <g transform="translate(55, 8)">
    <polygon points="0,-5 1.5,-1.5 5,0 1.5,1.5 0,5 -1.5,1.5 -5,0 -1.5,-1.5" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Extra tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="8" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="5" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="45" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>

  <!-- Small sparkle stars scattered -->
  <g transform="translate(70, 35)">
    <polygon points="0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(15, 40)">
    <polygon points="0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
  </g>
</svg>
